title: Device configuration
description: Configures a device instance in the device tree (a *.device.json). It identifies the device description the instance is based on and holds the configuration of each registered extension to the device configuration format.

deviceDescription.title: Device description
deviceDescription.description: Identifies the device description this configuration is based on.

defaultSnippets.label: Example device description
defaultSnippets.description: Identification taken from the device description.

checksum.description: Optional checksum of the device description, used to detect that it has changed. Currently unused

extensions.description: A dictionary in which extensions store their configuration, keyed by extension. Each key is defined by the extension that registers it in the base system, not chosen when editing this file; the extension developer gives it a globally unique prefix (e.g. company_name.key). Each entry has a `configuration` property, in which the extension stores its own settings for the device, plus an optional `ioMapping` property holding the device's I/O mapping managed by this extension entry.

defaultSnippets.label: Example extension entry
defaultSnippets.description: The base-system PLC configuration under its extension key.

.*.description: Unique extension key. The extension must register this key in the base system. An extension can also make multiple registrations.

BaseDevice.PlcConfig.title: Device PLC configuration
BaseDevice.PlcConfig.description: I/O handling and stop behaviour settings of a PLC device. This is the 'configuration' an extension stores under the base-system PLC key in a *.device.json.

BaseDevice.GenericDeviceConfig.title: Device parameter configuration
BaseDevice.GenericDeviceConfig.description: Configures the parameter values of a device. This is the object under extensions["BaseDevice.GenericDeviceConfig"].configuration in a *.device.json.

BaseDevice.GenericIoMapping.title: Device I/O mapping
BaseDevice.GenericIoMapping.description: Maps a device's I/O channels to IEC variables or addresses. This is the 'configuration' an extension stores under the base-system I/O-mapping key in a *.device.json.

modbus.tcp.server.title: Modbus TCP Server Configuration
modbus.tcp.server.description: Schema for the extensions["modbus.tcp.server"].configuration payload. Mirrors ModbusTcpServerDataSchema (Zod) 1:1.

extension.title: Extension entry
extension.description: What an extension stores for the device under its key.

configuration.title: Configuration
configuration.description: The extension's own settings for the device. Its shape is defined by the extension that registered this key (for example the base-system PLC, generic-device and I/O-mapping extensions).

ioMapping.title: I/O mapping
ioMapping.description: The device's I/O mapping: input, output and bidirectional channel mappings.

defaultSnippets.label: Example I/O mapping
defaultSnippets.description: One input channel with a bit sub-mapping and one output channel.

inputMappings.description: List of input mapping configuration parameters

outputMappings.description: List of output mapping configuration parameters

bidirectionalMappings.description: List of bidirectional mapping configuration parameters

deviceIdentification.title: Device identification
deviceIdentification.description: Identifies the device description this device instance is based on.

defaultSnippets.label: Example device identification
defaultSnippets.description: Numeric type, id and version taken from the device description.

type.title: Type
type.description: Numeric device type from the device description.

id.title: Id
id.description: Device identifier from the device description.

id.title: Id
id.description: The id of the parameter, references the parameterId from the DevDesc, required when specifying multiple parameters with the same name, otherwise optional

mappingTarget.title: Mapping Target
mappingTarget.description: The (fully qualified) name of the variable the channel or component is mapped to: either the name of a new variable to create or the fully-qualified name of an existing variable.

BaseDevice_PlcConfig.title: Device PLC configuration
BaseDevice_PlcConfig.description: I/O handling and stop behaviour settings of a PLC device. This is the 'configuration' an extension stores under the base-system PLC key in a *.device.json.

defaultSnippets.label: Example PLC configuration (keep values on stop)
defaultSnippets.description: Bus cycle on MainTask; outputs keep their current values when the controller stops.

defaultSnippets.label: Example PLC configuration (run program on stop)
defaultSnippets.description: Runs a user program on stop; requires stopResetBehaviourUserProgram.

applicationForIoHandling.title: Application for I/O handling
applicationForIoHandling.description: Name of the application that is responsible for the I/O handling. The code generated from the devices is generated for the application that bears the name provided here

updateIosInStop.title: Update I/Os in stop
updateIosInStop.description: States if the values of I/Os are also updated when the plc is in stop mode

stopResetBehaviour.title: Stop reset behaviour
stopResetBehaviour.description: States the behaviour of the I/Os when the controller enters stop mode

generateForceVariables.title: Generate force variables
generateForceVariables.description: States if two global variables are created for each I/O, which can be used to force the input or output value of the respective I/O

showIoWarningsAsErrors.title: Show warnings as errors
showIoWarningsAsErrors.description: States if warnings concerning the I/O configuration are displayed as errors

deviceDiagnosis.title: Device diagnosis
deviceDiagnosis.description: States if the diagnostics for devices are enabled

symbolicIoAccess.title: Symbolic I/O access
symbolicIoAccess.description: States if input and output variables are automatically created for the I/O channels of the plc

busCycleTask.title: Bus cycle task name
busCycleTask.description: The name of the bus cycle task for the respective device.

stopResetBehaviourUserProgram.title: Stop reset behaviour user program
stopResetBehaviourUserProgram.description: Name of the program to be executed when the controller enters stop mode. Only takes effect if stopResetBehaviour has value 'ExecuteProgram'

updateAlwaysIo.title: Update I/Os always (legacy)
updateAlwaysIo.description: Legacy flag. Ignored on read and never written; I/Os are always updated. Present only in files written by older versions. Will be fully supported in future versions.

BaseDevice_GenericDeviceConfig.title: Device parameter configuration
BaseDevice_GenericDeviceConfig.description: Configures the parameter values of a device. This is the object under extensions["BaseDevice.GenericDeviceConfig"].configuration in a *.device.json.

defaultSnippets.label: Example device parameter configuration
defaultSnippets.description: A host connector parameter set that assigns a binary literal to one device parameter.

parameterSets.title: Parameter sets
parameterSets.description: Structure for the configuration of device parameters

deviceParameterSet.title: Device parameter set
deviceParameterSet.description: Parameter values configured for the device's own parameter set (parameters not tied to a connector). Each entry names a device-description parameter and its configured value.

hostParameterSets.title: Host parameter sets
hostParameterSets.description: Parameter values configured per host connector. Each key is the connector id (an integer, from the device description) and its value is the list of configured parameters for that connector.

name.title: Parameter name
name.description: The name of the parameter in the corresponding DevDesc

id.title: Parameter id
id.description: The id of the parameter in the corresponding DevDesc (optional if parameter name is unique)

parameterValue.title: Parameter value
parameterValue.description: Structure for specifying the configured value of the parameter

components.title: Parameter components
components.description: The components of a structured parameter value

value.title: Value
value.description: The scalar value assigned to the parameter, written as a JSON string, integer, or boolean. String values may hold IEC literals such as binary. Numbers must be integers.

defaultSnippets.label: Example binary literal value
defaultSnippets.description: A scalar value written as an IEC binary literal.

defaultSnippets.label: Example min/max components
defaultSnippets.description: A structured value expressed as a list of named components.

value.title: Component value
value.description: The specific plain value of the parameter component

modbus_tcp_server.title: Modbus TCP Server Configuration
modbus_tcp_server.description: Schema for the extensions["modbus.tcp.server"].configuration payload. Mirrors ModbusTcpServerDataSchema (Zod) 1:1.

ipAddress.description: IPv4 address of the Modbus TCP server (slave).

enableFallbackIp.description: Use secondIpAddress as a fallback address (ConnectivityRedundancy).

secondIpAddress.description: Second IPv4 address, used when enableFallbackIp is true.

connectInactiveLine.description: Also establish a connection on the currently inactive line.

cycleTime.description: Cycle time in ms (used when trigger=Cyclic).

watchdogTimeout.description: Watchdog timeout in ms (used when enableWatchdog is true).

coils.description: Number of coils (used when enableDiscreteBitAreas is true).

discreteInputs.description: Number of discrete inputs (used when enableDiscreteBitAreas is true).

addressCoils.description: Start address of the coils area.

addressDiscreteInputs.description: Start address of the discrete-inputs area.

addressHoldingRegisters.description: Start address of the holding-registers area.

addressInputRegisters.description: Start address of the input-registers area.

serialGatewayActive.description: Enable the serial Modbus gateway (uses comPort/baudRate).

comPort.description: Serial COM port (used when serialGatewayActive is true).

baudRate.description: Serial baud rate (used when serialGatewayActive is true).

networkInterfaceName.description: The name of the network interface as registered in the operating system.

ipAddress.description: IPv4 address of the network interface.

adjustOperatingSystemSettings.description: Apply these settings to the operating system's network configuration.
